desc:
NATURALLY FLAVORED: Fruit-flavored, gummy treats made with no artificial flavors for a delicious snack

WHOLESOME: A sweet snack you can feel great about

ON-THE-GO SNACK: 50 calories per roll, these individual snacks are the perfect addition to any day out

CONTAINS: 3 Count
features:
Features

  1. Strawberry Blast flavor fruit roll-ups
  2. Gluten-free and gelatin-free
  3. Made with real fruit puree (pear concentrate)
  4. 50 calories per roll
  5. 7g added sugar per serving
  6. Fortified with Vitamin C

Benefits

  1. Safe for gluten-sensitive and vegetarian diets
  2. Provides a small vitamin C boost
  3. Low in calories — guilt-free treat
  4. Perfect for lunchboxes and on-the-go snacking
  5. Helps with portion control
  6. No need to refrigerate — easy storage
ingredients: Corn Syrup, Sugar, Pear Puree, Maltodextrin, Palm and/or Palm Kernel Oil. Contains 2% or less of: Citric Acid, Sodium Citrate, Monoglycerides, Fruit Pectin, Malic Acid, Vitamin C (ascorbic acid), Natural Flavor, Color (red 40, yellows 5 & 6, blue 1).
